A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Spiced Meat Skewers can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] by combining [[Raw Meat]] and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. By eating them, [[Link]] can replenish some of his lost [[Heart]]s. The Goron Spice covers up the scent of the [[Meat]], which allows its flavor to shine. Link can add extra [[Ingredient]]s while making Spice Meat Skewers, which results in the following variations: * '''Hearty Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. Eating these [[Meal]]s will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be partially refilled if he eats them. * '''Enduring Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. When eaten, they completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's movement speed. * '''Spicy Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when he eats these meals. * '''Electro Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Eating them will provide Link with a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. By eating them, Link's [[Defense]] will increase. * '''Sneaky Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Link's [[Stealth]] will be boosted when he eats them. * '''Chilly Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A special Goron spice covers up the scent of the meat, allowing its flavor to shine.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Spiced Meat Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] a piece of [[Raw Meat]] with [[Goron Spice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer * Meal * Prime Spiced Meat Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
